hero.headline: Hi, I'm a Marketing Strategist helping brands bring structure and taste into how they are perceived.
hero.subhead: With experience spanning across Public Relations, Content, Product Management and Brand Strategy, I like shaping narratives into campaigns worth remembering.

journey.title: More than a marketer, I'm a learner at heart.
paragraphs: Curiosity is my default. I like figuring out how things work, how people read between the lines, and why some ideas feel instantly right while others don't land at all.

I started out in PR, content and marketing, where I built a strong instinct for messaging and perception. That naturally pulled me toward strategy: thinking not just about what a brand says, but what it delivers and how all the pieces come together. Product became part of that journey because I wanted to understand the core itself, which gave structure to my creativity.
Lately that instinct has narrowed toward a specific world — culture, lifestyle & brand building — where taste and strategy have to hold together at once.
